title: Oven Roasted Smoke Hot Mexican Chicken Breast Sopes
description: A buttery, springy, comforting Mexican dish featuring chicken breast, with a smoke-hot flavor, diabetic-friendly ingredients, and a traditional sopes form.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together smoke hot sauce, olive oil, lime juice, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken breast pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil and spray with cooking spray, then arrange the chicken pieces on the baking sheet.
Bake the chicken in the preheated oven for 25 minutes, or until cooked through.
While the chicken is baking, prepare the sopes shells according to package instructions.
Once the chicken is done, let it rest for 5 minutes before slicing into thin strips.
Assemble the sopes by placing a few slices of chicken onto a sopes shell, topping with shredded cheese and chopped cilantro.
Serve the sopes hot and enjoy.
